summary: Built ContractDetailPage (src/pages/ContractDetailPage.jsx) as the full screen frame: breadcrumb header, Add Folder/Tag action, gradient status banner, a 2-stat strip (Current Version, Activity Entries), and a tab bar driven by ContractDetailResponse.availableTabs. Implemented Details, Document, Versions and Activity Log tab content (ContractDetailsTab, ContractDocumentTab, ContractVersionsTab, ContractActivityLogTab) plus AddFolderTagDialog, all wired to real endpoints via a new contractRepositoryService.js and feature hooks under src/features/contract-repository/. Routed at /contracts/:contractId in App.jsx (matching the navigation ContractRepositoryListPage already performs). 401/403 on contract load renders the existing AccessDeniedView; the Add Folder/Tag control is hidden for roles the folder-tags endpoint disallows (Legal Reviewer, Approver). Clauses/Approvals/Signatures/Obligations tabs render a link-out panel since their content belongs to other tasks/modules. Verified with lint (0 warnings), vitest (85/85 passing, incl. 6 new tests for loading/populated/tab-navigation/access-denied/role-gating), and a production build, plus a live-rendered screenshot comparison against IMG-2/3/4 using a disposable local mock backend (not part of the app) — Details/Document, Versions and Activity Log tabs visually match the target designs closely.

code_files.description: Routed PAGE: header/breadcrumb, status banner, stat strip, tab bar driven by availableTabs, and tab content switch; renders AccessDeniedView on 401/403.
Core contract metadata card for the Details tab.
Document viewer placeholder + download control for the Document tab, handling oversized/corrupted/missing states.
Version history table for the Versions tab.
Read-only, immutable Activity Log list for the Activity Log tab.
Dialog to assign folders/tags to the open contract.
Status badge for this module's contract status enum (distinct from uc123's StatusBadge/enum).
Fetches ContractDetailResponse; exposes HttpError for 401/403 access-control handling.
Fetches the paged ActivityLogEntryResponse list and total count.
Fetches FolderTagOptionResponse options for the Add Folder/Tag dialog.
POSTs AssignFolderTagRequest to assign folders/tags to a contract.
Date/currency/relative-time formatting helpers shared by this module's tab components.
Typed client for the life-cycle-uc8-uc9 `/api/v1/contracts` + `/api/v1/folder-tags` endpoints, kept separate from uc123's contractsService.js since the response DTOs differ.
Zustand slice holding the open contract and active tab, per the module's contractDetailSlice contract.
Screen-level tests: loading, populated Details tab, tab navigation, access-denied on 403, and role-based Add Folder/Tag visibility.
Added the /contracts/:contractId route for ContractDetailPage (ContractRepositoryListPage already navigates here on row click).

pr.title: feat(ui-gen): build ContractDetailPage with tab navigation
pr.body: Implements ContractDetailPage (life-cycle-uc8-uc9 module) per UC8-BR-007/008/009/010 and UC8-MF-001: header, status banner, a tab bar driven by the backend's `availableTabs`, and Details/Document/Versions/Activity Log tab content, each wired to its own endpoint via a new contractRepositoryService.js. Includes AddFolderTagDialog with role-gated visibility, AccessDeniedView reuse for blocked direct links, and a new route at /contracts/:contractId. See blockers for inferred fields, omitted stats requiring out-of-scope endpoints, and an owner-overlap note with T-CONTRACT-REPOSITORY-PAGE-UI's task file.

blockers: Task-ownership overlap: T-CONTRACT-REPOSITORY-PAGE-UI's own TASK.md lists ContractDetailsTab, ContractDocumentTab, ContractVersionsTab, ContractActivityLogTab and AddFolderTagDialog under its 'What you own' section too, even though this task's design images (IMG-2/3/4) show those exact tabs as ContractDetailPage's own content and this task's acceptance criteria (UC8-MF-001, UC8-BR-007..010) require them to work. Since neither task's output existed yet, I implemented these components here so ContractDetailPage is actually usable and testable; if the other task also creates same-named files, they will need to be reconciled/deduplicated by whichever lands second.

Inferred fields not in ContractDetailResponse: the design (IMG-2) shows 'Contract Type' and 'Department' rows on the Details tab and a renewal countdown ('Renewal in 42 days') plus 'Signatures Collected' / 'Obligations Due Soon' stat cards. None of these have a backing field in ContractDetailResponse, and the renewal/signature/obligation summaries would require GET /api/v1/contracts/{contractId}/renewal, an approvals/signatures summary, and an obligations summary — none of which are in this task's endpoint allowlist. I omitted all of the above rather than fabricate values; only 'Current Version' (from the Versions endpoint) and 'Activity Entries' (from the Activity Log endpoint) are rendered in the stat strip, and the status banner drops the renewal clause.

Inferred field for Versions 'File' column: ContractVersionResponse has no dedicated file-name field. I render `changeSummary` in that column as the closest available data, which only coincidentally matches the design's file-name format when the backend populates changeSummary that way.

Design shows a contract status value of 'Active', which is not in the documented status enum (Draft, In Negotiation, In Approval, In Signature, Executed, Expired, Terminated, Renewed, Amended). I render whatever string the API returns rather than hard-coding 'Active'; StatusBadge falls back to a neutral style for any unrecognized value.

The Document tab's Download control links directly to `documentUrl` from the already-fetched ContractDocumentResponse rather than calling GET /document/download, because that download endpoint (and the reusable DownloadButton atom) belong to the separate T-DOWNLOAD-BUTTON-UI task and are outside this task's endpoint allowlist; a disabled 'File unavailable' state is shown when downloadEnabled is false or the document is oversized/corrupted/missing.

Clauses, Approvals, Signatures and Obligations tabs render a lightweight link-out panel instead of inline content, since that content belongs to other already-built modules (clause-analysis, esignature) or a not-yet-built task (ObligationsRenewalPage) and none of their endpoints are in this task's allowlist. Clauses links to the existing /contracts/:contractId/clause-analysis route and Signatures to /contracts/:contractId/signers; Approvals links to the global /approvals list (no contract-scoped approvals route exists yet, so this is an inferred best-effort link); Obligations shows a static message with no link since no route exists yet for it.

Visual verification used a disposable local mock HTTP server (not committed) standing in for the real backend, since no backend was running in this environment; it was only used to drive a live browser render for the screenshot comparison and was torn down afterward.
